problem_statement:
Bug#29484519 PARTIAL REVOKE & DB LEVEL GRANT DO NOT NULLIFY EACH OTHER FOR ROLE
             AGGREGATION

Description:
------------

- Suppose there are two roles granted to a user. One role has a partial revoke,
  and another user has a DB level grant. In case user activates both the roles
  then in theory partial revoke and DB level grant should negate each other and
  user must see only the global privilege. Instead, the behavior was such that
  server used to remove the partial revoke but not the DB grant.
- In practice it is not functional issue because user would still have the
  global privilege.
- The reason it happened because we did not consider the use case that we
  would have to update the DB level temporarily for the session.
